body: Integration note (UMA): #1147 (#1109 open-profile wire runs) adds side left|right runs that end at a run-out point with no return to the threading point, no start hole and no slug. When #1147 combines with this PR, the post must not assume a closed visit and verification must skip the start-hole/slug rules for open runs. UMA will do that integration on a branch stacked on both.

Merged `issue/533-wire-iso-post` (#1139) into this branch to resolve the combined conflicts (`posting_wire.rs` add/add, `posting.rs`, `wire_contour.rs`: keep both sides) - merge `8cd0aff6`, no rebase, no force-push.

- `posting_wire.rs`: one module holding #533's `stream` (op_streams' wire section) and #534's `wire_clause` (verification_report); `posting.rs` mounts it once as `wire` and re-exports `wire_clause`, `WireClause`, `WIRE_VERDICT`.
- `wire_contour.rs`: asserts the machine note now says the wire laws judge at the post AND the wire cut streams with `EdmCondition C110`.
- New `test(app)` `3e852d68`: `wire_post::the_wire_laws_stand_between_the_cut_and_its_nc_text` - a clean punch posts through `wire-iso.cps` to #533's golden (unchanged) with the wire verdict on the not-judged line; a die whose kerf burns the plate above its opening still streams but `post_script` refuses it by name (`Die1: wire gouge: ...`) and writes no NC file.

Gate on head `3e852d68`: `cargo xtask gate quick --base origin/issue/533-wire-iso-post` green (4 steps, 0 failed, 10.4 min; `wire_post` 5, `wire_contour` 7, `wire_verify` 3 among the app suites); `cargo clippy -p camcraft-sim -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` clean. PR is now stacked on #1139.

This conflicts with main (37d93ae5). Please `git merge upstream/main` (NeoTech/Camcraft main) into the branch and push. Conflicting files: crates/app/src/operation/job.rs, crates/app/src/operation/stamp.rs, crates/app/tests/golden_cl.rs and crates/ui/src/egui_app/panes.rs - the job builder, the kind-scoped stamp digest, the golden CL list and the pane registry all moved on both sides since your head; merge main and re-apply your additions on top.

Refresh note from M5 (for this PR's owning session): #551 and #560, the EDM base this draft was built on, merged to main at 14:06Z. This draft now conflicts, and its diff still carries the old copy of that base. When you next work it, one `git merge upstream/main` (keep both sides; take main's version of the #551/#560 files) should drop the duplicated base and shrink the diff. #1208 is different: wait until the sinker chain (#1131 → #1136 → #1156) merges, because it's built on it. The maintainer has decided reviews are NeoTech's only, so no pr-reviewer marker and no merge-ready from our sessions.

Merged the refreshed parent, then main, to resolve conflicts. The new head is af7008a9.

- `git merge origin/issue/533-wire-iso-post` (3dd4b820) merged with no textual conflict. The parent's moves are carried through as the parent has them:
  - the no-tool posting rule now sits in `posting_family.rs`, using `family_at_post`
  - `"codes"` is in `edm.rs` `COMMON_KEYS`
  - the kind-aware `parse_edm` and the exhaustive `default_post_for` are kept
  - #534's `wire_clause` call in `verification_report_by` and its `pub use` in `posting.rs` are kept beside them
- `git merge upstream/main` (0757563d) was already up to date through the parent.
- `git diff upstream/main` lists only the chain's files. Beyond #1139's own files, it adds only #534's: `sim::verify::wire`, `operation/wire_verify.rs`, `tests/wire_verify.rs`, `tests/posted_gates/wire.rs` and the decision file.

One follow-up commit, af7008a9 (`test(app)`), handles the `UNJUDGED` entry that the parent added for `wire_contour_punch`, which cited #534.
- This PR builds the verifier for that golden, so the posted-golden guard (`solid_law_goldens::every_posted_golden_is_a_program_the_gate_passes`) now judges it through `verify::wire::judge`. That is the kerf, threading and slug laws that `wire_clause` runs.
- The entry is dropped.
- The harness is the new `tests/posted_gates/wire.rs`. It regenerates the punch the way `golden_cl` makes it and proves the output byte-identical to `wire_contour_punch.cl`. It then judges the program at full precision against the profile through 12 mm, inside an 80 x 80 plate.
- `the_slot_trace_and_plasma_goldens_pass_their_gates` also pins the verdict: no findings, and the freed piece holds the part, so the check cannot pass without judging anything.
- Two other routes were tried and rejected:
  - Judging the micron-quantised CL text directly fails the kerf law at 0.2 µm, because the CL text's 1 µm grid is coarser than `KERF_TOL` (0.1 µm).
  - A document-route regeneration through the slicer does not reproduce the clean golden profile.

Targeted gate:
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` is green: post, sim, motion and app suites (including `solid_law_goldens`, `wire_contour`, `wire_post` and `wire_verify`) and ui suites, 5 steps, 0 failed, 17.1 min.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-sim -p camcraft-post -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` is clean.

The PR stays a draft, stacked on #1139. Ready for a re-check (/resolve-conflicts check).
Quick pass (M5): body complete, gate reported green on this head, no open requested change; flagged ready for review. Conflicts with main (if any) are refreshed at merge time (PROCESS_VERSION 31).

Merged main into the branch (af7008a9 -> 9b13e16c) to resolve conflicts, and turned the PR back into a draft for the push. Resolved: crates/app/src/operation/mod.rs (kept both: wire_verify plus main's sinker_op and sinker_side_op module lines); crates/app/tests/solid_law_goldens.rs (took main's rewrite of the unjudged-golden guard, which drops the UNJUDGED list; this PR's wire_contour_punch.cl entry in the judged list and its wire-law assertions are untouched and still apply). Tests: solid_law_goldens, wire_post, wire_verify, wire_contour and sim wire lib tests all pass; clippy -D warnings clean on camcraft-app and camcraft-sim. Awaiting a review of this head.

**Ready for the maintainer to merge** (safety-floor review; head 9b13e16c, merged with current main 64506ff5, trial merge "Already up to date").

**The remerge (9b13e16c) checked with `git show --remerge-diff`**
- `operation/mod.rs`: both sides kept - `wire_verify` (this PR) beside main's `sinker_op` / `sinker_side_op`. Nothing of main dropped.
- `solid_law_goldens.rs`: main's `posted_golden_verdict` guard and its unit test are intact, no `UNJUDGED` list remains. The wire punch is still judged: `judged.push(("wire_contour_punch.cl", wire_findings()...))` feeds the guard's `names`, and `the_slot_trace_and_plasma_goldens_pass_their_gates` asserts the wire laws find nothing and that the punch frees the part (`product_area > 0`). The wire golden is therefore not left unjudged and not wrongly synthetic-marked.
- `git diff origin/main` of these two files and `posted_gates/mod.rs` shows only this PR's additions.

**What looks good**
- Wire clause sits beside the plasma clause in `verification_report_by` (posting.rs), every finding a blocking problem, no warning tier; a missing path, condition, part (stock-sourced cut) or an unsliceable section is refused by name.
- `sim::verify::wire` is pure (path, kerf offset, side, start, sections); `polyline` refuses arcs, poses, plane changes and gaps; no unwrap/expect/panic in non-test code; casts and indexing guarded (`polyline[0]` only after the non-empty check).
- Layering and placement fine: wire laws in `crates/sim`, app glue reads the world; no new `camcraft-*` dependency, no build.rs/.github/scripts/process-file change (so no PROCESS_VERSION bump needed), no snapshot PNG or golden change, decision file `docs/decisions/534-wire-verify.md` present with dropped alternatives, provenance lines present, new files under 400 lines.

**Local results (merged with main)**
| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p camcraft-sim --lib` | 118 passed |
| app: wire_verify 5, wire_post 4, wire_contour 5, solid_law_goldens 4, post_not_judged, mcp_wire_contour, wire_readers, edm_machine, plasma_post, posting | all passed |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-sim -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |

The full quick-gate plan was not run (the `operation/mod.rs` touch maps to nearly every app suite); the suites above are the ones covering the touched modules.

**Requested before merge**
None.

**Notes (not blocking)**
- Per the decision file, no capture/tab law yet (#539) and the threading clearance equals the kerf offset (no hole diameter modelled).
- PRs #1147, #1158, #1160 and #1163 are stacked on this one.
- The PR is still a draft from the merge-time refresh; draft state left untouched.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Merge-time refresh class: DELTA (merge of main with two hand resolutions: crates/app/src/operation/mod.rs kept both sides, crates/app/tests/solid_law_goldens.rs took main's side). Stands on the full review of head 9b13e16c (review comment above). Flagging ready for the merge; nothing is pushed after this.
